dedupe_keys.name: popclusters sub saharan africa population and electrification polygons

description: PopClusters publishes population-cluster polygons for 44 sub-Saharan African countries, with population, area, night-light and urban classification attributes. The Scientific Data article identifies shapefiles for the national sets, while the own Mendeley deposit and DOI registration name the resource and state CC BY 4.0. A modeller can join clusters to candidate grid extensions or decentralised generation sites when estimating electrification demand. Lit pixels are an indicator of likely electricity access, not a household connection census; settlement definitions and the 2016 population calibration limit direct use for current planning. The public repository HTML did not enumerate individual files in this text client, so I did not claim that a particular download link worked. I read named metadata and article file descriptions without obtaining polygons. The related clustering code is reviewed as a separate G1 item. No exact catalogue resource was found. A limitation is that night-light classification can miss unlit connected households and count non-household lights.
